title: Signature Contextual UTF-8 Repair
description: A Signature original: invalid sequences are repaired using surrounding context when the intent is unambiguous, and rejected only when truly ambiguous - with every repair logged. Repair beats silent mojibake. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Form-Preserving Normalization
description: A Signature original: normalization records the original form alongside the canonical one, so display can use the author's exact bytes while comparison uses the canonical form. Fidelity plus correctness. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Source-Hinted Detection
description: A Signature original: detection weighs hints from the data's source - region, era, application - dramatically improving accuracy on ambiguous bytes. Hints are declared per source. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature BOM-Normalizing Pipeline
